author: Emma Roth
description: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant.
title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent

The movies are available in Meta's TV app and include titles like Avatar, Spider-Man: Far From Home, Jurassic World Rebirth, Wicked: For Good, and a Billie Eilish concert film co-directed by Eilish and James Cameron.

description:
Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm "in time for the holidays in December," but he didn't provide a price at the time.

description:
The Federal Communications Commission voted unanimously to allow state and local prisons to jam cellphones. In an announcement on Thursday, the FCC argues the rule will help combat an "influx of contraband cellphones" used to carry out crimes from prison.

Jammers are generally banned under Section 333 of the Communications Act of 1934, though they're used
title: FCC greenlights rule allowing prisons to jam cellphone signals

description: Back in my day, the only “Doorbuster” sales were at physical retail stores. But now, you can get ultra-low prices before Black Friday whether you want to shop in-store or online. description:
Valve announced some updates about Steam Machine availability today, including good news if you want to buy one right now and potential bad news about future supply due to RAMaggedon.

The good news: you can now purchase a 512GB Steam Machine without getting on a waitlist. Initially, interested buyers had to get on Valve's waitlist if they wanted to purchase one, but the console-like PC is now available in an "add-to-cart" status, according to the company. As I write this, the 512GB versions with and witho
title: You can now buy a Steam Machine without getting on a waitlist

description:
For years, influencers have come up with workarounds on social media to figure out how to share affiliate links with followers. A new integration between Instagram and Amazon was announced earlier this month as a way to make it easier for influencers to make money from affiliate links - but some content creators are suspicious about who really benefits.

title: Some creators are skeptical of Instagram’s new affiliate program

description:
Google's Gemini app for macOS now has computer use, meaning it can help you "get multi-step tasks done across your local files, desktop apps, and the web," the company says. Google suggests the feature might be useful for things like speeding up workflows, filling in forms, making presentations, and listing items for sale.

Users will be able to decide which of your apps Gemini can access, and be able to follow along as Gemini works because it has its own background window that shows a live preview in your chat, Google says. The feat
title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

description: New leaked images of Motorola's next folding smartphone shared by SammyGuru add more credence to the theory that widescreen could be the default design for foldables moving forward. Following a single leaked shot shared to Reddit yesterday, this new crop of images reveal the Motorola Razr Flex from several angles in two finishes with its inner screen
title: Leaked images reveal Motorola’s wide foldable

title: Oh, Elon Musk is ‘moderate’ now, is he?

description: Jon McCormack, Apple's vice president of camera software engineering, left the company last month, Bloomberg reports. title: Apple’s iPhone camera leader has reportedly left the company

description:
Amazon is serving up push notifications and banners on its home page to some users, warning that a new bill could add up to $5 per order in New York City. The Delivery Protection Act, which is backed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani and a number of labor groups, including the Teamsters, would require Amazon to employ its current fleet of third-party delivery contractors directly.

title: Amazon is pushing alerts opposing NYC’s Delivery Protection Act

Anthropic has officially gone public. It began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT" at $111.50 per share, up from its initial $83 per share price that put company's value at around $1.5 trillion.

title: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street

description:
We could all use a hand when it comes to being more mindful about our health and fitness. The holidays provide plenty of reasons to focus on wellness in body and mind, and a good gift can be just the thing to spur a new hobby or support healthy habits. With that in mind, we're here to help you turn those good intentions into a great buy.

title: The Verge’s 2026 fitness and wellness gift guide

description: ChatGPT can receive audio prompts from your microphone faster now with a Live Dictation feature that transcribes as you speak, rather than waiting until you finish recording. It's rolling out now globally on all ChatGPT plans on the web, desktop app, and iOS and Android apps. While using dictation in ChatGPT, you can tap or click the audio waveform to show the live text transcript the AI is generating,
title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation

description:
Today, I’m talking with Jon Favreau, a political commentator and cofounder of Crooked Media. You probably know Jon best from a little show called Pod Save America, which Jon started with a group of fellow Obama staffers in the wake of Donald Trump’s election in 2016. It’s now one of the most popular podcasts in the country.

Since then, Pod Save America and the company created around it, Crooked, have become one of the major success stories of independent liberal media. So one of my central questions for Jon was
title: How Silicon Valley lost the public, with Crooked Media’s Jon Favreau

author: Hayden Field
description:
Today is a new beginning for Anthropic: a years-in-the-making IPO that beat out SpaceX for most valuable of all time, having raised $81.3 billion and set an important precedent for the other public AI lab debuts to come. But it's not simply a financial milestone.

Anthropic was founded on the idea that it prioritized safety more than other labs; its founders had left executive research positions at OpenAI. As the AI race has accelerated, though, its executives have emphasized that Anthropic can only fulfill this mission by coming in first place, requiring lots of money and compute. Unsurprisingly, thoughtfu
title: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic’s ‘good guy’ reputation is on the line

author: Cameron Faulkner
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI is finally here for millions of players who own a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X / S, and those who plan to buy a console, despite rising costs this year, just to play it. As you have likely already noticed, the launch is inescapable, and that's especially tough if you're a PC gamer.

I'm sorry to remind you that the clock has only just now started ticking down to

description:
Google is teaming up with Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin to launch its AI server satellites. The companies announced on Thursday that Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket will shuttle satellites equipped with Google's Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) into space in the first quarter of 2029.

The partnership is part of Google's Project Suncatcher,

description: Grand Theft Auto VI, in many ways, tries to simulate real life. And life in 2026 would not be complete without a smartphone. You may try to escape into a fantasy of robbing banks and fighting drug lords, but you can't get away from texts from your m

description:
Canva will now allow you to turn off its generative AI features. With this change, you can disable the graphic design platform's array of AI tools, such as its AI photo-extending Magic Expand feature, as well as turn off the ability to generate images with its Canva chatbot.

title: Canva adds an AI ‘off’ button

author: Arielle Duhaime-Ross
description: In a dark room, a man with a camera makes his pitch: Therapy isn't the first treatment you should get if you have anorexia or bulimia, he says. He's in his late 20s, wearing a backward camo baseball cap and a silver chain. "Instead of going straight to the therapy, let's do a keto diet where we encourage you to eat as much as you want" - all while limiting your carbohydrate intake to 30 grams a day.
